title.zh: 美联储「经济强劲」定调遭华尔街广泛质疑
title.en: 美联储「经济强劲」定调遭华尔街广泛质疑

current_state.zh: The Fed held rates steady and upgraded its view of the US economy to 'strong,' drawing widespread Wall Street skepticism as long-end Treasury yields sold off and the 2-year/10-year spread widened to as much as 34.1 basis points.
current_state.en: The Fed held rates steady and upgraded its view of the US economy to 'strong,' drawing widespread Wall Street skepticism as long-end Treasury yields sold off and the 2-year/10-year spread widened to as much as 34.1 basis points.
